sources.locator: "First Liberian Civil War", revision 1374428613, § Second Liberian Civil War

explanation: The English article on the first war carries the second as its own last section and states the interval: "The peace lasted for two years until the Second Liberian Civil War broke out when anti-Taylor forces invaded Liberia from Guinea in April 1999", the invaders being the dissidents the first war had driven out. The settlement of 1997 is what the second war was a failure of.
